name: Breda (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, yellow and black, the yellow charged with the black goat of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 6 September 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4727 of 27 September 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, vertical tricolour red, yellow with the black goat of the arms at the centre, and black.

features.role: goat of the arms, 13/32 of the height
